Prym_residue.interpretation: Determinant zero removes the norm component but does not trivialize the Prym component.

base_Brauer_normalization.relative_Jacobian: J=K3 x E with zero section z

theorem.name: DeterminantZeroSpectralGerbePrymReductionTheorem
theorem.statement: After the unique zero-section normalization of the Poincare gerbe, the determinant-zero spectral condition forces the norm of alpha|C, and hence the trace of beta_C, to vanish. The unresolved analytic obstruction lies in the eight-dimensional trace-free/Prym component.
